title: 第1章
content_zh: 初到异世 001，穿越我，苏涟漪，对天起誓，永不行医！说完这句话，便陷入黑暗，永远与这世界挥别。一道带着恐惧的女声刺耳——“翠儿姐，这花痴死了，怎么办！？”本以为以后的世界是永远的死寂，但不知从什么时候开始，又闹哄一片。隐约中，苏涟漪只觉得有人在自己鼻下人中部位探了一探。“啊！她真死了，怎么办？翠儿姐。”又有人喊了一句，那声音颤抖得更厉害。“死……死了……”终于，被称为翠儿姐的女子颤抖着说话，硬撑着冷静下来，“这个贱人死就死了，我们……我们不知道原因，我们根本没来过这！”“对，我们没来过这，我们快走。”一旁的女子们也附和起来。紧接着，便是狼狈的逃跑声。当室内完全静了下来，苏涟漪确保没有危险，这才忍住身上的疼痛，咬牙睁开眼。她没死！？当看到周围环境时，苏涟漪马上惊恐的睁大了双眼。这里不是医院，这里是哪！？入眼是简陋的屋顶，用木头拼成，没有吊顶，可见粗大的梁木。室内稍显昏暗，从简陋的屋顶渗下金色细碎的光线。房梁木上引下了许多绳，绳上吊了一些篮筐，是最老式手工编织的篮筐。再看向周围——土砖砌的炤台，上面放着铁锅，一摞摞白色盘子叠在一旁，可以看出这里是厨房。苏涟漪顿生警觉，这里非但不是医院，怕也不是城市，难道自己被劫到了山里？硬撑着坐起身来，当看到自己的手时，更是吓得想惊叫，因为，这分明不是她的手，这手又胖又白，皮肤还算细嫩，但绝对是一个胖子的手，哪是她从前苗条的身材可比？赶忙又低头看了衣服，是土绿色的粗布衣裙，中间系着黑色腰带，腰带一旁坠着一只粗糙的荷包。视线继续向下，粗粗的腿上有一双小却肥的脚，套着同样土绿色的绣鞋，圆溜溜的。原始的厨房，古式衣裙，绣鞋……如果这里不是什么拍摄现场，那便是……古代！？饶是再淡定的涟漪，此时也是大脑空白，完全懵了。伸手摸脸，入手的还是肉。这里是厨房，虽没有镜子，却在门旁有一口大缸。她跌跌撞撞地爬起来跑到缸前向内望——平静的水面上倒影着一张脸，如此陌生。整齐厚重的齐刘海，因几日未洗，油油腻腻，刘海下是圆滚滚的脸，虽然白得如同十五的月亮，却长了不少粉刺，白得白，红的红，有的甚至还冒了白头，让人反胃。一双眼是十分漂亮的，又大又圆、黑白分明，鼻子也算挺翘，但脸上这些白粉是胭脂还是面粉？这腮上红彤彤的两片又是什么？不得不说，脸主人的品位十分奇怪。涟漪楞了一下，马上反应过来，这脸的主人好像就是她。这怎么可能！？她什么时候变成了这幅摸样？难道是……借尸还魂！？正当她惊讶得摸不到头绪时，从房门外传来越来越近的嘈杂声。“你是说苏花痴死在了厨房？”是上了年纪的女声，音色很是刻薄。“刘妈妈，是啊，这可怎么办啊？”是刚刚那翠儿的声音。苏涟漪立刻打起了精神，直觉告诉自己，她们说的是她。“你这个笨丫头，平日里看你聪明，今儿今天就犯这糊涂事？”那刘妈妈继续道，“死了就死了，但别留厨房，直接扔后院井里，人不知鬼不觉！”苏涟漪一惊，理智瞬间恢复，她们是要杀人灭口？不对，此时应该叫毁尸灭迹才最恰当。刘妈妈带着一群丫鬟们冲到了厨房门前，涟漪已没机会再逃走。她没死，如果翠儿发现她没死，会不会为了灭口而将她投井？她刚刚死里逃生，绝对不能再死一次！此时想活下去，必须自救！众人入了厨房，看见站着的苏涟漪一愣，那翠儿更是如同见了鬼似的惨叫——“苏涟漪，不是我杀的你，是你自己摔倒的，你不要来找我报仇啊。”原来翠儿以为苏涟漪是诈尸了。刘妈妈也是一惊，向后退了一步，但到底是见多识广，很快便稳下心神，“你是人是鬼？”涟漪急中生智，赶忙道，“刘妈妈，我自然是人啊，好好的人怎么能变鬼？”神态尽量自然，模仿这些人说话的腔调，唯恐外人看出她的破绽。刚刚从翠儿口中得知，这个老女人是刘妈妈，而她在这个诡异的世界也叫苏涟漪。刘妈妈五十左右年纪，脸上满是皱纹，个子不高，却透着一股子精明，那一双不算大的绿豆眼此时更是恶狠狠地散发阴气。涟漪觉得，与其说她像鬼，还不如说这刘妈妈像鬼——厉鬼。“翠儿姑娘说的不错，刚刚我确实是摔倒晕过去，轻轻摔了一下，怎么会死呢？”涟漪笑着，继续道。刘妈妈瞪了翠儿一眼，怨她大惊小怪。翠儿怒了，冲上来就是一巴掌，“你这个花痴贱人，装神弄鬼的吓唬我，看我不打死你！”但这巴掌却没打上，涟漪很巧妙的微微一侧身，伸手就势扶上了额头，“哎呀，怎么头有些晕？”就这样不着痕迹的躲过了这一巴掌。刘妈妈怒了，“翠儿，你真是没把我刘老婆子放在眼里，在我面前还敢放肆？苏涟漪没死，难道你不甘心，非要让我们李府沾上命案？”翠儿赶忙收回了手，退到刘妈妈身边，脸上堆满了讨好的笑容，“刘妈妈息怒，翠儿这是和苏涟漪闹着玩呢，怎么会让我们李府牵上命案呢？”虽然口中这么说着，心中却十分鄙夷——这老东西背地里害死的人还少吗，处理死人得心应手，现在这么发脾气多半是不想自己牵扯其中。医生的观察是十分敏锐的，两人的举止神态被苏涟漪看了个通透。苏涟漪并非是那种手无缚鸡之力的弱女子，从小习武术、大学时为了缓解精神压力练习跆拳道，所以，刚刚躲开巴掌看似幸运，实赖她灵敏的反应。她抬眼不着痕迹地看向翠儿的双眼，虽有着骄纵，但好歹没有戾气，说明翠儿还不会杀她灭口，暗暗放下心来。“苏涟漪，你帮你哥送酒来李府，如今这酒也送到了，钱也拿到了，就别在二少爷房前转悠了，李家可是岳望县的名门望族，不是随便的小家小户可以高攀的起的，何况你还是个有夫之妇，你好自为之吧。”刘妈妈的话说得还算客套，但语气却满是鄙夷。涟漪一愣，为兄长送酒？李家？二少爷？高攀？有夫之妇？－－－－－－题外话－－－－－－1V1种田宠文，没看过种田宠文吧？很宠的那种，不会虐心虐肺被人欺负误会等等等等等。丫头的老公是WOW玩家，经常逼着丫头陪他打竞技场。明明码完字累得要死还要集中精力、提心吊胆玩游戏，丫头觉得那不是玩游戏而是自虐！因此，此文诞生，丫头的宗旨是——希望给放学后、下班后、哄娃娃睡觉后的大小妹子们，一个放松的世界，一个宠的世界，一个忘记一切疲惫烦恼的世界。希望贫嘴丫头能带给你们快乐，贫嘴丫头一直在努力——everyday！
content_en: First arrival in another world 001, traveling through me, Su Lianyi, swore to God never to practice medicine! After saying these words, he fell into darkness and said goodbye to this world forever. A female voice filled with fear was harsh - "Sister Cui'er, this nympho is dead, what should I do!?" I thought that the world would be eternally silent, but I don't know when it started, and it became noisy again. Vaguely, Su Lianyi only felt that someone was probing the philtrum under her nose. "Ah! She is really dead, what should I do? Sister Cui'er." Someone shouted again, and the voice trembled even more. "Dead...dead..." Finally, the woman known as Sister Cui'er spoke tremblingly, trying to calm down, "This bitch is dead if she dies. We...we don't know why, we have never been here at all!" "Yes, we have never been here, let's go quickly." The women on the side also agreed. Immediately afterwards, there was the sound of embarrassment running away. When the room became completely silent, Su Lianyi made sure that there was no danger, then endured the pain in her body, gritted her teeth and opened her eyes. She's not dead! ? When she saw her surroundings, Su Lianyi immediately opened her eyes in horror. This is not a hospital, where is this! ? The first thing you see is a simple roof, made of wood. There is no suspended ceiling, and thick beams can be seen. The interior was slightly dark, with tiny golden light seeping from the simple roof. There are many ropes drawn from the beams, and some baskets are hung on the ropes. They are the oldest hand-woven baskets. Looking around again - there is an adobe-made stove with an iron pot on it and stacks of white plates stacked aside. It can be seen that this is a kitchen. Su Lianyi suddenly became alert. Not only was this not a hospital, but it was also not a city. Could it be that she had been robbed into the mountains? She forced herself to sit up, and when she saw her hand, she was so frightened that she wanted to scream, because it was clearly not her hand. It was fat and white, with fairly delicate skin, but it was definitely the hand of a fat man. How could it compare to her slim figure before? He quickly lowered his head to look at the clothes. It was an earth-green coarse cloth dress with a black belt tied in the middle. There was a rough purse hanging on the side of the belt. Looking down, there is a pair of small but fat feet on the thick legs, wearing the same earth-green embroidered shoes, which are smooth and round. Original kitchen, ancient dresses, embroidered shoes... If this is not a shooting scene, it is... ancient times! ? Even though Ripple was calm, his mind was blank at this time and he was completely confused. He reached out and touched his face, but what he got was still meat. This is the kitchen. Although there is no mirror, there is a large vat next to the door. She stumbled up and ran to the tank and looked inside - there was a face reflected on the calm water, so unfamiliar. Her neat and thick bangs were greasy from not being washed for several days. Under the bangs was a round face. Although it was as white as the fifteenth moon, it had a lot of acne, ranging from white to red, and some even had whiteheads, which made people feel sick to their stomachs. The eyes are very beautiful, big, round, black and white, and the nose is quite upturned, but are the white powder on the face rouge or flour? What are those two red spots on the cheeks? I have to say that the owner of the face has very strange taste. Ripple was stunned for a moment, and then realized immediately that the owner of this face seemed to be her. How is this possible! ? When did she become like this? Could it be...resurrection from a dead body! ? Just when she was so surprised that she couldn't figure out what to do, there was an increasingly close noise coming from outside the door. "You mean Su Huaidi died in the kitchen?" It was an older female voice with a very mean tone. "Mother Liu, yes, what should we do?" It was Cui'er's voice just now. Su Lianyi immediately cheered up and intuitively told herself that they were talking about her. "You stupid girl, I think you are so smart on weekdays, why do you do this stupid thing today?" Liu's mother continued, "If you die, die, but don't leave the kitchen alone, just throw it into the well in the backyard without anyone noticing!" Su Lianyi was startled, and her rationality came back instantly. Are they going to kill people and silence them? No, it would be most appropriate to call for destruction of corpses and traces at this time. Mother Liu rushed to the kitchen door with a group of maids, and Ripple had no chance to escape. She is not dead. If Cui Er finds out that she is not dead, will she throw her into a well to silence her? She just escaped death and must not die again! If you want to survive at this time, you must save yourself! When everyone entered the kitchen, they were stunned when they saw Su Lianyi standing. Cui'er even screamed as if she had seen a ghost - "Su Lianyi, I didn't kill you, you fell down yourself. Don't come to me for revenge." It turned out that Cui'er thought Su Lianyi was a fake corpse. Mother Liu was also shocked and took a step back, but after all she was well-informed and quickly calmed down, "Are you a human or a ghost?" Lianyi thought quickly and said quickly, "Mother Liu, of course I am a human. How can a good person become a ghost?" She tried to be as natural as possible, imitating the tone of these people's speech, lest outsiders would see her flaws. I just learned from Cui'er that this old woman is Mother Liu, and her name is Su Lianyi in this weird world. Mother Liu is about fifty years old, her face is full of wrinkles, she is not tall, but she exudes shrewdness, and her pair of medium-sized mung bean eyes are exuding a sinister aura. Ripple felt that instead of saying she looked like a ghost, it would be better to say that Mother Liu looked like a ghost - a fierce ghost. "Miss Cui'er is right. I did fall down and fainted just now. I fell slightly, how could I die?" Ripple smiled and continued. Mother Liu glared at Cui'er and blamed her for making a fuss. Cui'er got angry and rushed towards her and slapped her, "You nymphomaniac bitch, you're trying to scare me, I'll beat you to death!" But the slap didn't hit you. Ripple cleverly turned to one side and put her hand on her forehead, "Oh, why are you feeling dizzy?" She dodged the slap without any trace. Mother Liu was angry, "Tui'er, you really don't take me, Mrs. Liu, seriously, and you dare to be so presumptuous in front of me? Su Lianyi is not dead.
